caption: The drawing depicts two objects placed side by side on a rectangular, light beige section centered against a larger off-white background. Both objects are rendered with colored pencil or pastel, predominantly using shades of pink, purple, yellow, green, blue, and outlined in dark gray. The object on the left is a rounded, arch-shaped form with a decorative floral pattern, showing detailed flower and leaf motifs in yellow, green, and red on a pink background, bordered by parallel stitched lines. The object on the right is a view of a slipper or shoe from above, showing an oval toe area in dark purple with a pattern of radiating pink lines, a pale yellow area above the toe with multicolored floral designs, and two side flaps in pink and light green hues; the outline and details are accented with dark lines. The overall arrangement places each object isolated but parallel to each other, centered on the page.
title: Moccasin
